_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
I ye Player {player_id} ye kɛlɛbaga LinesOfAction la.
A ma kɔlɔsi ye '{side}', a kɔlɔsi tɛmɛ ye '{other}'.
Kɛlɛbaga bɔnɛ: `[b1b3]` (kɔɔrɔdɔnɛ kɔɔrɔdɔnɛ). Kɛlɛbaga tɔgɔ ye kɔlɔnɛnɛ, wolonɛnɛ, wala kɔɔrɔnɛnɛ, a ma kɔlɔsi tɔgɔ ye kɔlɔnɛnɛ bɛɛ la. I ka kɔlɔsi wolonɛnɛ, nka a kɔlɔsi tɛmɛ mɔ; a kɔlɔsi tɛmɛ kanɛ bɛ a fa. I ye kɛlɛbaga kɔlɔsi 8-kɔɔrɔdɔnɛ ye, i ye kɛlɛbaga la.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O sɛbɛri ka kan k'a kɛ e2e4 ye (ka bɔ,kɔnɔbɔyɔrɔ la).
invalid_move.identical: A bɔyɔrɔ n'a tagayɔrɔ ye kelen ye.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: A ka ɲi k'a kɛ siratilennin na wala a kana tɛmɛ o kan.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Kɛlɛbaga tɔgɔ ye kɔlɔsi tɔgɔ ye kɔlɔnɛnɛ la.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: An jugu ka kɛlɛkɛwotoro dɔ be sira dira an ma.
invalid_move.destination_own: A yɛrɛ ka kɛlɛkɛwotoro kelen lo tun b'a tagara yɔrɔ min na.

game_action.captured_suffix: Jokali {player_id} donyi {from} -> {to} ka kɛɛ donyi dɔgɔtigɛ.

outcome.draw_no_capture: A y'a kɛ cogo di do? - O ye kabako lo ye.
outcome.draw_repetition: A y'a ka jɔyɔrɔ fɔ siɲɛ saba.
